items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: And he used to talk about Gus Matkazzo. Boy that man could take a baritone and lead a band. Saved a lot of trumpet players.

ctx.x: And I took that parade from nine and more until six and even.

And didn't weaken. I played all the way through. You played every number from top to bottom? Every number. But no, I'd take down for the baritone a while. But I'd go back and go up again. The baritone was the only one holding it up. He'd play the lead? Yeah, baritone always played the lead. It's like the trumpet. And he used to talk about Gus Matkazzo.
